Package Group3.controller

Class MealController

java.lang.Object
Group3.controller.MealController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/meals") public class MealController extends Object
Controller responsible for managing meal-related operations. Provides endpoints to: - Retrieve meals for a user - Retrieve a specific meal - Create, update, and delete meals All endpoints require a valid user ID from the request.
